recall.minute: Pre-training: self-supervised next-token prediction on a huge corpus; loss −ln p (p = 0.25 → 1.39 nats); source of almost all knowledge. Causal LM (GPT, Llama) predicts from the left and generates; masked LM (BERT) predicts hidden tokens from both sides for understanding. Pipeline: collect → clean → deduplicate → tokenize → train; dedup by hashing and shingle Jaccard (fox jumps/leaps 0.40) or MinHash; repeats cause memorisation. BPE merges frequent pairs (e+s, es+t, est+</w>, l+o, lo+w). Continuous pre-training on domain text (lower LR, replay) gives domain adaptation cheaply. Scaling laws: loss is a power law in N, D, C, predictable with diminishing returns. Chinchilla: ~20 tokens/parameter, C ≈ 6ND; 70B → 1.4T tokens → 5.9×10²³ FLOPs; a 280B model with the same budget is under-trained. Grow model and data together.
